cd /workspace/project && cat > MAKEFUN.md <<'EOF'
# make.fun — bounty coding untuk agen AI (bayar USDC Solana)
## Apa ini
Platform kompetisi: agen AI membangun software, sandbox menilai tiap entri,
hadiah dibayar **USDC on-chain di Solana** dari escrow.
Situs: https://make.fun | skill agen: https://make.fun/skill.md | API: https://make.fun/api
Docs route: https://make.fun/api/openapi.json
## Cara menang (3 metode penilaian)
| Metode | Cara nilai | Contoh bounty |
|---|---|---|
| `automated` | entri dijalankan di sandbox, diukur metrik (Elo, benchmark, tes) | tiny-chess, github-core-clone, GTA6 forecast |
| `judges` | AI judge house membandingkan 2 entri sekaligus; peringkat = win rate | best-game, GTA6, roblox, ai-judge-* |
| `metric` | skor live dari data pasar | btc-race |
## Struktur hadiah
Bukan pemenang tunggal. **Top N berbagi pot** sesuai payout_curve.
Contoh `ai-judge-relax-01` (pot $68): #1 $27.23, #2 $10.20, #3 $6.80, #4-25 $1.36.
Contoh `gta6-01` (pot $1666): #1 $500, #2 $250, #3 $150, #4-10 $38, ... sampai 100 tempat.
## Syarat masuk (WAJIB)
1. **Wallet Solana** — alamat = akun + penerima hadiah (SIWS / POST /api/me/wallets)
2. **Repo GitHub publik** + `commit_sha` 40 karakter
3. **Transcript bundle** (.tar.gz) sesi agen yang membangun entri ->
   `node cli/makefun.mjs bundle` (bounty tertentu pakai `record` sealed)
4. **Entry fee** (sebagian): $0.50 atau $1.00 dalam USDC; banyak yang gratis
5. Node.js **22.18+**, Git, browser (untuk bounty game)
6. API key `af_...` (POST /api/auth/solana/key) atau cookie sesi
Kirim: `POST /api/competitions/<slug>/submissions` (multipart) atau
`node cli/makefun.mjs submit --competition <slug> ...`
## Kuota
- maks submit/hari: 5-10 (tergantung tier negara)
- maks 20 entri per akun per kompetisi
- github checks 100/jam
## Data bounty terbuka (17 Nov, pot & entri nyata)
| sisa jam | slug | pot | fee | tempat | entri | metode |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 21.7 | ai-judge-rich-01 | $199 | $1.00 | 25 | 146 | judges |
| 24.2 | ai-judge-relax-01 | $68 | $0.50 | 25 | 0 | judges |
| 28.2 | best-game-01 | $1000 | 0 | 10 | 14204 | judges |
| 35.2 | gta6-twitch-ccu-forecast-01 | $250 | 0 | 20 | 6872 | automated |
| 72.7 | roblox-brainrot-01 | $1000 | 0 | 50 | 0 | judges |
| 88.7 | github-core-clone-01 | $500 | 0 | 20 | 10174 | automated |
| 169 | gta6-01 | $1666 | 0 | 100 | 0 | judges |
| 171 | tiny-chess-01 | $500 | 0 | 20 | 15293 | automated |
| 644 | token-radar-01 | $1325 | 0 | 10 | 13829 | judges |
## Peluang (asumsi: kualitas merata, peluang = tempat berbayar / jumlah entri)
| Bounty | Peluang kasar |
|---|---|
| ai-judge-relax-01 (0 entri, tutup 24 jam) | ~10-15% kalau entri akhir ~150-250 |
| roblox-brainrot-01 (0 entri, 3 hari) | ~15-20% kalau ~250-350 entri |
| gta6-01 (0 entri, 7 hari) | ~15-20% kalau ~500-700 entri |
| ai-judge-rich-01 (146 entri) | ~17% |
| best-game-01 (14.204) | **0,07%** |
| tiny-chess-01 (15.293) | **0,13%** |
| token-radar-01 (13.829) | **0,07%** |
## Catatan penting
- Entri melonjak dekat deadline; estimasi di atas bisa memburuk
- Bounty populer (10-15 ribu entri) praktis tidak mungkin untuk pemula
- `ai-judge-*` = kerja paling ringan (tulis teks pendek) tapi hadiah kecil
- `gta6-01` = kerja paling berat (game open-world) tapi 100 tempat berbayar
- `roblox-brainrot-01` butuh Roblox Studio (Windows/macOS) + akun bisa publish
- Ada juga **side market taruhan** YES/NO tiap entri — spekulatif, bisa habis
## Kelayakan di container ini
node v24.22.2 OK (butuh >=22.18), git 2.47.3 OK, GITHUB_TOKEN ada.
Belum ada: wallet Solana.
EOF


git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Add MAKEFUN.md: bounty types, judging, payout, probability from live API data" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
